import json

_ = len(moon_page) + len(kipchoge_page)

distance = 356400  # km (minimum perigee value on Moon page: 356,400 km)
marathon_dist = 42.195  # km

# Kipchoge's marathon times:
# 2:01:09 (Official WR set in Berlin 2022)
# 1:59:40 (Ineos 1:59 challenge)
# 2:01:39 (WR set in Berlin 2018)

t_20109 = 2 * 3600 + 1 * 60 + 9      # 7269 s

calc_results = {}

    thousand_hours = hours / 1000.0
    rounded_thousand_hours = round(thousand_hours)

        "speed_kmh": speed_kmh,
        "hours": hours,
        "thousand_hours": thousand_hours,
        "nearest_thousand_hours": rounded_thousand_hours
    }

print(json.dumps(calc_results, indent=2))
